description_en: Hangs up a call in Communication Intelligence Engine
description_zh: 通信智能引擎中主动挂断通话
name: HangupOperate

parameters.description_en: The call ID. Obtain this ID from the response of the [LlmSmartCall](~~2862828~~) or [LlmSmartCallEncrypt](~~2881065~~) operation.
parameters.description_zh: 通话回执ID。您可通过[LlmSmartCall](~~2862828~~)或[LlmSmartCallEncrypt](~~2881065~~)接口获取通话回执ID。
parameters.help_en: The call ID. Obtain this ID from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2862828.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2881065.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 通话回执ID。您可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2862828.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2881065.html接口获取通话回执ID
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to hang up the call immediately. Valid values:

- true (default): Hangs up the call immediately.

- false: Hangs up the call after the current playback finishes.
parameters.description_zh:
是否立刻挂断。取值：

- true（默认值）：立刻挂断。

- false：前正在播放的内容播放完再挂断。
